d.t: Water based polyurethane cementitious hybrid coating
d.s: Sikafloor-31 PurCem is a multi-component, water-based coloured polyurethane hybrid flooring coating. It has a matt, impervious, chemical resistant, hard wearing surface.
a: Can be applied to substrates with high moisture content (7 days old or mature damp concrete or 10% moisture pbw)
us: Sikafloor-31 PurCem is used as top and wear coat layer in Sikafloor 22 PurCem anti-slip system build-ups and as a stand alone coating.
d.pk: Part A | 1.30 kg plastic bottle Part B | 1.50 kg plastic bottle Part C Pigment | 1.60 kg plastic bags 0.4 kg Plastic tub Part A+B+C+pigment | 4.8 kg ready to mix units

The package must be stored properly in original, unopened and undamaged sealed packaging, in dry conditions at temperatures between +5 °C and +30 °C.
Beware of condensation! The substrate and uncured floor must be at least 3 °C above dew point to reduce the risk of condensation or blooming on the floor finish.
Can be installed on substrates with higher moisture content. No ponding water. Check rising moisture. The substrate needs to be visibly dry and have adequate pull-off strength min 1.5 N/mm2.

Sikafloor PurCem Accelerator: the aid in the speed of cure for Sikafloor-31 PurCem add 5ml of PurCem accelerator to Sikafloor-31 PurCem to approximatley the halve time to return to service as above

Premix part A with a low speed electric stirrer and then add pigment and mix until uniform. Add part B and mix for 30 seconds, until a uniform colour is achieved. Use a double paddle (axis) mixer and gradually add part C (aggregate) to the mixed resin. Allow part C to blend for further 2 minutes minimum, to ensure complete mixing and a uniform moist mix is obtained. During the operations, scrape down the sides and bottom of the container with a flat or straight edge trowel at least once (parts A+P+B+C) to ensure complete mixing. Mixing Tools A low speed electric stirrer (300-400 r.p.m.) and an Exomixer-type mixing paddle suited to the size of the mixing container to minimise the air entrapment.

On smooth screeds apply the mixed Sikafloor-31 PurCem using a short or medium nap roller directly from a paint tray. On broadcasted screeds pour the material and spread it using a squeegee and then back-roll the excess using a medium knap roller.
Clean all tools and application equipment with Thinner C immediately after use. Hardened / cured material can only be mechanically removed.

handling.text: Avoid formation of aerosol. Do not breathe vapours or spray mist. Avoid exceeding the given occupational exposure limits (see section 8). Do not get in eyes, on skin, or on clothing.
